title: Erdős-Gyárfás problem for partially ordered sets
summary: Given integers $p,q,t$ with $1 \le t \le p$ and $1 \le q \le h_p(t)$, a strong $(p,q,t)$-coloring of the Boolean lattice $B_n$ is a coloring of its $t$-chains such that every induced copy of $B_p$ in $B_n$ uses at least $q$ colors on its $t$-chains. Let $f_t^{\sharp}(n,p,q)$ denote the minimum number of colors in such a coloring. We study this Boolean-lattice analogue of the Erdős-Gyárfás function.We first show that every finite poset strongly embeds into a Boolean lattice.
